Border Security and Immigration | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Border Security and Immigration Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email The policies of the Biden-Harris administration led to a historic crisis at our southern border. As a result, we have seen record numbers of illegal crossings and thousands of fentanyl deaths. I believe we need to reinstate the Remain in Mexico policy and continue constructing our border wall to protect our national security.

---
[https://maloy.house.gov/Issues/Issue/?IssueID=15132]
Congress | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Congress Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email America has the greatest system of governance in the world, and Congress is one of our key institutions. However, the executive branch has become too powerful and assumed Congress’ job of legislating. I believe we need to rebalance the powers between our three branches of government, and Congress needs to reclaim its rulemaking authority. Defense and National Security | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Defense and National Security Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email We live in an increasingly dangerous world, and America’s military faces constant threats from China to Iran. Ensuring that our military remains strong and well equipped to defend our freedoms is essential. Additionally, Utah plays an important role in manufacturing and modernizing our national defense systems. It is also home to critical military bases like Hill Air Force Base and the Tooele Army Depot. As a member of Congress, I will continue fighting for Utah’s defense priorities and to support our military families. Related News Rep. Celeste Maloy Votes in Favor of Bill to Reform FISA April 12, 2024 | Posted in Press Releases All Related News »

Economy and Jobs | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Economy and Jobs Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email In a post-Chevron world, Congress has the chance to dismantle the administrative state and build a new regulatory framework, one that focuses on the intent of its laws. Regulatory reform, including permitting reform and reining in government overreach, will be key to strengthening the U.S. economy. A smaller federal government leads to a strong and healthy job market, especially for Main Street and America’s small businesses. Related News Rep. Energy, Natural Resources, and Public Lands | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Energy, Natural Resources, and Public Lands Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Local communities should have greater control in the management of our natural resources. These include energy generation and transmission, mining, oil and gas drilling, public lands, and water. I also believe in the ‘all-of-the-above' approach to ensure U.S. energy independence. We need to use and develop a combination of resources to meet our energy needs. I will continue to support greater domestic production of fossil fuels, geothermal and nuclear energy, and critical mineral mining. Religious Freedom | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Religious Freedom Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email I believe in protecting the right to religious freedom. It is among the first rights guaranteed by the Constitution and is one of the key pillars established in the foundation of this country. I will work to protect the right to teach, practice, worship, and observe religion, in public or private, for all individuals.

[https://maloy.house.gov/Issues/Issue/?IssueID=15140]
Second Amendment | U.S. Representative Celeste Maloy Skip to Content Second Amendment Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email I am a strong supporter of the Second Amendment which guarantees our right to keep and bear arms. I oppose any efforts to weaken this fundamental right or take firearms away from peaceful, law-abiding American citizens. I believe we need to focus on policies that will keep guns out of the hands of those who want to cause harm and invest in mental health resources to prevent future violence. I also believe we have the responsibility within our communities to heal divisions and discord.
